FULL TEXT:
RECRUITMENT NOTICE
No. NU/NT/Job/Nov-III/2026 Date: 28.11.2026
Nalanda University, Rajgir is an avant-garde “International” University, designated as
institution of “National Importance” established by an Act of the Indian Parliament (Nalanda
University Act, 2010) under the aegis of the Ministry of External Affairs, GOI.
The Kautilya Global Centre for State Capacity, hosted by Nalanda University, is being established
as a leading Global South platform for advancing research, executive education, policy dialogue,
and international collaboration on state capacity and public-sector governance. The Centre will
generate policy‑relevant knowledge, translate research into practical learning for civil servants
and public leaders, and foster South–South exchange across governments, training institutions,
universities, multilateral organizations, and other partners. Through its research, learning, and
convening activities, the Centre seeks to strengthen the capabilities of public institutions and
contribute to more effective, responsive, and accountable governance.
The University invites applications from eligible candidates for engagement of project position on
contract on consolidated Pay basis for PROGRAM MANAGER of the Secretariat at Kautilya
Global Centre for State Capacity, a flagship initiative focused on advancing research, executive
education, policy dialogue, and international collaboration on state capacity and public-sector
governance.
SL DETAILED ADVERTISEMENT
1
PROGRAM MANAGER
No. of the Post : 01
Nature of Engagement : On Contract for a period of 01 Years Initially
(Extendable subject to satisfactory performance and requirement
of the University)
Consolidated Pay : Rs. 1,25,000/- (per month all inclusive)
Minimum Educational Qualifications & Experience
 Master’s degree with a minimum of 55% marks in Public Administration, Public Policy,
or any allied field.
 Minimum of 5 years of experience with government, autonomous, or multilateral bodies
in areas concerning state capacity, governance, capacity building, and allied areas.
 Strong programme management background in executive education, civil-service
training, or capacity-building, ideally in a multi-stakeholder or donor-funded
institutional setting.
 Demonstrated experience in designing and delivering training programmes, workshops,
or convenings, including scheduling, logistics, and setting up operational systems,
processes, and workflows.
 Experience managing cross-functional teams, faculty and participant engagement,
programme feedback and evaluation, and reporting cycles.
 Experience working with government, civil-service training institutions, or multilateral
stakeholders will be preferred.
 Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills for engaging faculty, senior
officials, and international partners.
Key Responsibilities
The Program Manager will work closely with the University’s leadership, faculty, and research
teams to help plan and deliver the Centre's executive education and civil-service capacity-
building programmes, workshops, high-level convenings, and other activities.
The Program Manager will be expected to work closely with the Coordinator of the Centre to:
 Design and manage executive education and civil-service capacity-building programmes
across the Centre’s thematic pillars (state capacity, water governance, digital governance,
disaster resilience, etc.).
 Plan and coordinate convenings, workshops, and policy dialogues, including agendas,
logistics, speakers, and communication with partners and participants.
 Manage faculty and resource-person engagement, including identifying, inviting,
briefing, and coordinating faculty, practitioners, and subject experts for programme
delivery.
 Oversee participant engagement, from nomination and onboarding to in-programme
support and post-programme follow-up, working with ministries, training institutions,
and partner organisations.
 Develop and manage programme delivery schedules, calendars, and budgets, ensuring
timely and high-quality delivery.
 Design and administer programme feedback and evaluation processes, and analyse
results to improve curricula and delivery.
 Supervise programme team members and coordinate with Post-doctoral Research
Fellows, including assigning tasks, reviewing drafts, and ensuring consistency and
quality of programme content and learning materials.
 Act as the primary internal liaison to the Technical Advisory Group for academic quality
review of programme curricula and learning materials prior to delivery.
 Facilitate the flagship report and the Good Governance Framework by drawing
programme insights and participant feedback into their content.
Duration and Terms
The appointment will be for an initial term of 1 year; renewable based on performance,
institutional requirements, and mutual agreement. The position will be full-time and based at
Nalanda University, with reasonable flexibility for travel and external engagements, as approved
by the University.
The Last date for receiving applications is 07.12.2026 Applications received after the
closing date will be rejected and no correspondence shall be entertained in this regard.
HOW TO APPLY:
1. Candidates are required to apply Online, only through the Link given at end of the
advertisement or on the University Website. No hard copy of the application will be
accepted.
Since the link is based on a Google Form, you are requested to log in to your Gmail
account before clicking on the link. If you do not have a Gmail Account, please create
one before accessing the link.
2. FILLING UP APPLICATION FORM AND FORWARDING THE FILLED FORM TO
RECRUITMENT CELL, NALANDA UNIVERSITY.
The application process has two mandatory stages- Filling of Application Form
(Google Form) and Forwarding copy of the filled Application Form with enclosures
of- Updated CV with Passport Size Photograph; Qualification Certificates and Mark
Sheets (Graduation onward only); Experience Certificates and Other relevant
supporting documents to recruitmentnt@nalandauniv.edu.in
FILLING OF APPLICATION FORM:
(i) Click on the given Link and carefully fill the Application Form, and then
SUBMIT.
(ii) After successful submission of the Application Form, you will receive a copy of
the Filled Application Form on your registered Email.
FORWARDING APPLICATION FORM
(i) The applicant is required to FORWARD (and not compose a separate email) the
copy of that filled Application Form received at his/her registered email to the
Recruitment Cell, Nalanda University at recruitmentnt@nalandauniv.edu.in
along with the following enclosure: Updated CV with Passport Size Photograph;
Qualification Certificates and Mark Sheets (Graduation onward only); Experience
Certificates and Other relevant supporting documents.
(ii) Enclosure: Enclosure should be a SINGLE PDF FILE Containing –all the
documents mentioned above.
3. Merely filling the Application Form shall not be considered completion of the
application process unless Application Form along with required document is
forwarded to recruitmentnt@nalandauniv.edu.in on or before the closing date of
the Notice. Failing this, the application shall be treated as Incomplete Application
and will be rejected.
4. Incomplete applications or applications without required supporting
documents; and application received after closing date will be liable to be
rejected, and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.
5. Enclosure should be a SINGLE PDF FILE only, containing- all the required documents
mentioned above. Submission of multiple files, separate emails, or files in ZIP, RAR,
or any other compressed file format will lead to rejection of the Application Form.
6. Applicants must use the same email address for filling the Application Form and
forwarding Application Form and other purpose.
7. Applicants must not submit the required documents separately or through
multiple/part-wise emails.
8. Documents must be clearly scanned using a proper scanner and submitted in a clean,
legible, and printable format. Scanned documents that are tilted, distorted, unclear,
cropped, or otherwise not suitable for printing (particularly scanned using mobile
phones) may lead to rejection of the application.
9. Applicants are advised to submit only ONE application for each post. Multiple
applications or multiple emails submitted for the same post may lead to rejection of
the application(s).
10. An application fee of Rs. 500/-(including GST) shall be paid online directly to the
University’s Bank Account (through Net Banking / UPI). The UTR
Number/Transaction Reference Number must be mentioned in the Application
Form for reference. Details of the University’s Bank Account are given below.
Name of Account : Nalanda University
Bank Name : HDFC Bank Ltd.
Account No. : 50100079546912
IFSC Code : HDFC0002059
Swift Code : HDFCINBB
Branch Address : Dharamsala Road, Rajgir – 803 116
GENERAL INSTRUCTION:
1. The Applicants must be citizens of India.
2. Candidates currently working in a government body, autonomous body, or Public
Sector Undertaking (PSU) are required to produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC)
when called for an interview or selection process.
3. The prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum requirements, and the
mere fulfilment of these requirements shall not entitle a candidate to be called for an
interview. Where the number of applications received is large, the University reserves
the right to restrict the number of candidates called for further stages of selection based
on qualifications, experience and overall suitability.
4. The candidate is responsible for the information filled in the Application Form.
5. Incomplete application Forms shall not be considered for shortlisting and the criteria
of shortlisting shall be as per the Institutional requirements and norms.
6. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the selection process. Any changes of dates etc.
also will be communicated either by publishing in the website and thus candidates are
requested to visit the website regularly.
7. The Nalanda University reserves all rights to increase or decrease the number of
position and fill/not fill the advertised post.
8. The interview shall be conducted in Offline / Online mode as applicable. Timings shall
be shared after the scrutiny of applications by email only.
9. The decision of the University related to all matters pertaining to the selection shall be
final and binding on the applicants. No candidate will have any claim for issue of
appointment letter, as a matter of right, even after recommendations by the Selection
(Interview) Committee.
10. Selected candidate must be ready to join immediately.
11. Any other rule, as applicable will be followed, although not mentioned above.
12. Intimation about the Shortlisted Candidates for Interview and the selected candidate
will be informed via email only and they are expected to join immediately. Applicants
are advised to mention their correct and active email ID in the application, as all
correspondences will be through email only. Hence, regular checking of the email by the
applicant is expected.
